EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE POONAKARY PRADESHIYASABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Poonakary Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the United National Party, the recognized political party to which SelvarasaNiroshan the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide uponreturned member of United National Party who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of the LocalAuthorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party has communicated his decision tonominate Krishnasamy Thivakaran to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Denicius Canute Aravintharaj, Returning Officer of the Poonakary Pradeshiya Sabha,acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatKrishnasamy Thivakaran was selected as the member of the Poonakary Pradeshiya Sabha.
D. C. ARAVINTHARAJ,Returning Officer,Poonakary Pradeshiya Sabha.District Election Office,Kilinochchi,31st July, 2019.
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
